summary.en: If you live in Japan, are aged 20 to 59 and are not in an employer's pension (Kosei Nenkin), you join the National Pension, whether or not you are a student or a foreign national. Register at the ward office. Students and people with low income can apply to defer or be exempted from the premium (to be checked).

lead.ja: 20{歳|さい}{以上|いじょう}60{歳|さい}{未満|みまん}で、{会社|かいしゃ}の{厚生|こうせい}{年金|ねんきん}に{入|はい}っていない{人|ひと}は、{国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}に{入|はい}ります。
lead.ja_easy: 20歳から59歳で、会社の年金に入っていない人は、国民年金に入ります。
lead.en: If you are 20 to 59 and not in an employee pension, you join the National Pension.

text.en: If you leave a job: within 14 days from the day after. For other cases (arriving from abroad, turning 20), ask at the counter (to be checked).

text.ja_easy: {区役所|くやくしょ}の{保険|ほけん}{年金|ねんきん}{課|か}
text.en: Insurance and Pension Section of your ward office (Ward Welfare Section at a branch office)

evidence.quote: お住まいの区の区役所保険年金課または支所区民福祉課で加入手続きをしてください

check_at_office_coverage.ja_easy: あなたの{年金|ねんきん}のことは、{区役所|くやくしょ}で{聞|き}いてください。
check_at_office_coverage.en: This app does not cover your pension case in detail yet. Ask the Insurance and Pension Section of the ward office.

text.ja_easy: {持|も}ち{物|もの}：{届|とどけ}{書|しょ}。{基礎|きそ}{年金|ねんきん}{番号|ばんごう}がわかる{書類|しょるい}か、マイナンバーカード。カードがないときは、マイナンバーがわかる{書類|しょるい}と、{在留|ざいりゅう}カードやパスポートなど。{出|だ}せるのは{本人|ほんにん}か{世帯|せたい}{主|おも}です。
text.en: Bring: the application form (National Pension insured-person notification). A document showing your basic pension number, or your My Number Card. Without the card: a document showing your My Number plus ID (driver's licence, passport, residence card, etc.). The insured person or the head of household files.

text.en: People on "Designated Activities" for medical stay or long tourist stay cannot join. They file an "exemption notice" at a pension office, with copies of the residence card and the designation document. Whether the pension office is the only place: ask (to be checked).

text.en: There are several kinds of exemption from the premium. Ask at the counter which one you can use. Bring: something showing your basic pension number and your residence card (students also bring a student ID).
